title: Pushout
description: JSON Schema for a pushout — the universal cocone over a span (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §4; Awodey 2010 §5.5). Dual to pullback. Given two morphisms f : C → A and g : C → B sharing a common domain (a span), the pushout is an object Q with two injection morphisms ι_1 : A → Q and ι_2 : B → Q such that ι_1 ∘ f = ι_2 ∘ g, universal among such squares.

span.description: The span f : C → A, g : C → B — two morphisms sharing a common domain.

pushout-object.description: The pushout object Q = A +_C B.

left-injection.description: The injection morphism ι_1 : A → Q.

right-injection.description: The injection morphism ι_2 : B → Q.
